messages:
Ivy: Thanks for the all-hands update 10. Quick hiring/org questions here so it's public.

Diego: Are we doing any headcount reductions?

Hannah: No layoffs. We're reshaping a few squads and reallocating open roles toward Dedicated and product infra.

Omar: Timeline for updated org charts? Need to set sprint capacity.

Ivy: New org map + CSV with owners by Tuesday EOD. We'll flag which roles are ringfenced.

Kelly: How will this affect promotion cycles?

Hannah: Promotions continue as planned. Managers will get a checklist to preserve visibility for folks moved across squads.

Diego: Contractor conversions? Any caps?

Ivy: Still allowed; teams must justify conversions against prioritized hires. Use the rubric on Confluence.

Omar: Can we get an APAC-friendly office hour?

Ivy: Yes 11 we'll run two sessions and publish a recording + 1-page digest.

Kelly: Where do we submit protected hiring lane requests?

Ivy: Short form to people-ops@redwood.company with a 1-paragraph justification.

Diego: Thanks 10 leaving questions here if anyone has role-specific callouts.
